ECP-GSS-1 IE Battery Draft Assumptions
This data has been collated using the best information available. Maximum Export Capacity (MEC) has been rounded up for reporting purposes, exact MEC figures have been used within the model. Data freeze date: Q1 2026.
Pipeline Battery Projects add up to an estimated 76 due to be connected Projects. 
This is an approximate Sum of Maximum Export Capacity (MEC) of 5632 MW and a sum of Total Battery capacity of 15217.75 MWh*.
To Note, for the purposes of modelling, the MIC has been set equal to the MEC.

* Due to the nature of technology configuration, an estimate may have been applied for Battery Capacity (MWh) due to far out date of connection. Please see below summary of data used.
